# MiroThinker runtime dependency

Runtime subset of [MiroMind MiroThinker](https://github.com/MiroMindAI/MiroThinker), commit `25bd91be4338180fdfd23b16a57b21f69533b836`, vendored for Event-Trader. Includes the agent application and tool library; upstream benchmark suites and evaluation launchers are excluded.
